name: AIOManager
description: AIOManager manages Stremio accounts and addons, with encrypted sync, addon backups, account mirroring, and watch history metrics.

notes.text: AIOManager serves HTTP on port 1610. Use an external HTTPS reverse proxy such as Caddy for browser encryption and sign-in features.

Back up /opt/aiomanager_data, including .env, aio.db, and server_secret.key. The encryption key is generated by AIOManager on first start. Configuration and data remain outside the application directory during updates.
Uses SQLite by default. PostgreSQL is optional; configure DB_TYPE and DATABASE_URL in /opt/aiomanager_data/.env to use an external database. Restart aiomanager after configuration changes.

Create your account through the dashboard. To disable new registrations after setup, set REGISTRATIONS_CLOSED=true. When using an HTTPS reverse proxy, set CORS_ORIGINS to your HTTPS domain in /opt/aiomanager_data/.env. Enable TRUST_PROXY only when the proxy overwrites forwarded client IP headers.
AIOManager is feature-complete and receives maintenance fixes. Upstream builds for amd64 and arm64; this LXC script has not yet been tested on arm64 hardware.
